name: vibejournal
description: A private, offline-first trading journal PWA. No backend, no account, no telemetry — every trade stays on your device.
author: Shahzaib mudasir

scripts.test: node tools/e2e.js && node tools/e2e2.js && node tools/e2e3.js
scripts.android:sync: node tools/stage-web.js && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:build: node tools/stage-web.js && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: node tools/stage-web.js && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
